description: Use this when someone gives a loan amount, an interest rate and a number of weekly, fortnightly or monthly repayments, and asks what each repayment is, what the loan costs in total, or what the rate really is a year, for example "a microfinance loan of 5,000 at 5% flat a month for 6 months". It handles a flat rate (interest on the whole amount for the whole term, common with microfinance and hire purchase) and a reducing-balance rate, and fees taken at the start. Do not use it for a loan repaid in one sum (use loan.one_repayment), for a mortgage with a changing rate, or to say whether a loan is a good idea.

currency.description: The currency, as its three-letter code (GHS, NGN, KES, ZAR...). Only labels the answer; leave out if unknown.

method.description: "flat" when interest is charged on the whole amount for the whole term; "reducing" when it is charged only on what is still owed. Leave out if unknown, and both are worked out.

rate_per.description: Whether the quoted rate is a month or a year.

rate_percent.description: The interest rate as quoted, in per cent, for example 5 for 5%.

repay_every.description: How often a repayment is made. Leave out for every month.

upfront_fee_percent.description: Fees taken when the loan is paid out, as a per cent of the amount. Leave out if none.

upfront_fees.description: Fees taken when the loan is paid out (processing, insurance, commitment), as an amount. Leave out if none.

name: loan.instalments
title: Repayments and yearly cost of a loan
